description: AM32 4-in-1 brushless ESC, 60 A continuous / 65 A burst per channel, 2-6S (6-30 V), AT32F421 MCU, 30.5 x 30.5 mm, with 8-pin SH connector to the DolphinRC F405 V3 flight controller.

params.description: + — battery positive (BAT+ / 电源正极). Input 6~30V (2~6S LiPo).

params.note: Large solder pad; stack ships with a 12AWG 12 cm red/black lead and XT60 male plug (product page). The included 35V 470uF low-ESR capacitor is soldered by the builder across +/- (each pad has a small hole for its leads, per review).

params.description: V / BAT — battery voltage passed to the flight controller over the 8-pin connector.
G / GND — ground on the 8-pin FC connector.
CUR — current sensor output to the FC current ADC. Current Sensor: Support (Scale=150 Offset=0).
M1 — ESC channel 1 signal input from the FC (8-pin connector).
M2 — ESC channel 2 signal input from the FC (8-pin connector).
M3 — ESC channel 3 signal input from the FC (8-pin connector).
M4 — ESC channel 4 signal input from the FC (8-pin connector).

params.note: Plug the included 50 mm SH 1.0 mm 8-pin cable into the FC's SH socket. Pin 4 (VOID) is unused; no ESC telemetry line.

SH 1.0 mm 8-pin socket; stack ships with a 50 mm SH 1.0 mm 8-pin cable for the FC-ESC connection (product page). Wire labels BAT GND CUR VOID M1 M2 M3 M4 (manual p4); ESC silkscreen V G CUR (blank) M1 M2 M3 M4 (manual p3). Pin 1 is not marked; order is given from the BAT end. The pads can also be soldered directly (review).

params.reason: Neither silkscreen nor manual marks pin 1; order taken from the BAT end so FC and ESC parts share one pinout (the included cable is 1:1).

params.note: Brushless phases are not polarity-sensitive: swapping any two phase connections reverses rotation direction.
